description: This file contains architecture-specific functions for managing user space and page tables in the Zephyr RTOS on x86 architecture, including context switch handling, thread preparation, and user mode entry.

methods.name: z_x86_swap_update_page_tables
methods.description: Updates the page tables for an incoming thread during context switch, handling privilege level and page table switching.

methods.name: z_x86_userspace_prepare_thread
methods.description: Prepares a thread for user space execution by setting up its stack and page tables, and determining the initial entry point.

methods.name: arch_user_mode_enter
methods.description: Transitions to user mode, setting up the stack and paging, and entering user space code.
